images.alt: The lower south island on a blue background. Orange colours cover fiordland north of doubtful sound, while yellow covers the remainder of fiordland. The rest of the south island is a neutral greenish colour. Text on the image reads MetService Heavy Rain Watches and Warnings. An orange rain icon with the text 9pm Fri - Noon Sat, and a yellow rain icon with the text 6pm Fri - 9am Sat sit beside fiordland.

post.text:
🌧️ Heavy rain and strong winds are on the way 🌧️ 

🌧️ An Orange Heavy Rain Warning has been issued for Fiordland north of Doubtful Sound, starting Friday evening as a front pushes onto the country. A Yellow Heavy Rain Watch extends further south, starting slightly earlier.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
